text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but I should assess each decision by its expected contribution to my portfolio, not by the gain I lock in.","My long stretch without trades is not itself evidence that holding was wise; I should review whether my positions and cash still fit my goals and risk tolerance.","I should treat each stock as part of one portfolio, not as a separate account anchored to its purchase price, and make decisions based on current prospects rather than avoiding the discomfort of a loss."]}
